title: Regime context — the regime the record was taken in

components.purpose: Say what regime the platform classified over each recorded series' window, beside what it classifies now — so a forward-return figure can be read against the kind of market it was earned in.
components.current_implementation: Four arms. `context`: one SeriesBlock per recorded series, alphabetical by coin then interval. `context-empty-series`: one sentence for a record whose every series is attempts-only (no captures, so no window). `never-recorded`: the shared how-recording-starts sentence. `unreadable`: role=alert danger-tinted block with the reason and the record's own survival sentence (does-not-mean-empty).
constraints: The four arms stay distinct — an unreadable store must never read as an empty record, and the platform's empty answers must never read as failures (spec: Each Series' Regime Reads Fail Alone, And Every Empty Answer Names Its Kind)

The store-failure arm deliberately does NOT use the shared WhyNotLoaded sentence: this arm's cause is the product's own store, and the shared sentence names BattleGrid (exempted with the stated reason in failure-is-explained.test.ts). A design must not wire it back in
Alphabetical series order is deliberate: the composition ranks nothing, and the order must not look like it does

components.purpose: One recorded series' regime story: its window, the composition of platform regime labels across that window, and the state the platform classifies now.
components.current_implementation: An h2 (`BTC · 1h`), a secondary window line (span + capture count), then HistoryLines and NowLine. Composition renders each regime label as <code> with its bar count, count-descending; a look-back that starts after the record's first capture states the span it actually covers; dropped points are counted out loud. `history-none` and `snapshot-unclassified` are the platform's own empty answers in their own terms ('not a failure'). The two unreadable arms are role=alert with the platform's reason plus the shared WhyNotLoaded sentence (subjects: 'this coin's regime history is' / 'this coin's current regime is'). The now line opens 'Now — not the window:' and carries conviction, run length, and every context axis the platform stated, names verbatim.
constraints: Regime labels and context axes are the platform's vocabulary rendered verbatim — a design may restyle them but must not translate, truncate to a fixed set, or map them to icons/colors keyed by label name, because the vocabulary changes under the product without notice (spec: labels SHALL be carried verbatim)
Every regime label renders with its bar count — never a share or a bar without its n (spec: never a share without its count)

The covered-span sentence must render whenever the look-back does not reach the window start — a composition quietly narrower than the record's window is the lie the surface exists to prevent (spec-pinned)
'Now' stays visually distinct from the window composition — the snapshot is the state now, not a summary of the window (spec: Now is not the window)
One series' failure renders inside that series' block only; the guard, per-series isolation, is the query's, and a design must not merge failed and healthy series into one banner

components.purpose: The composition half of a series block — what the platform's per-bar classification held across the record's window.
components.current_implementation: Plain paragraphs; see series-block. No table — the label list is inline prose with counts.

components.purpose: The snapshot half of a series block — the regime the platform classifies at this moment, kept apart from the window.
components.current_implementation: One sentence, opening 'Now — not the window:'; qualifiers (conviction, run length, context axes) are a single text run to keep the rendered text seamless.

components.purpose: Tell the reader their record and the platform's regime data still exist when a BattleGrid read fails, with the cause said accurately.
components.current_implementation: The shared sentence component, rendered per failed read inside the affected series block.
constraints: The sentence is the shared component and must stay it — a reworded copy is the drift it exists to prevent (failure-is-explained.test.ts)

components.purpose: Turn away a request with no authority.
components.current_implementation: Shared component rendered in place of the page body. Reachable only on a delegated deployment.
constraints: One page for every cause; they differ in cause and not in remedy (design W-C)

flows.name: Read the regime beside the forward returns
steps: open /recorder/analysis and read the figures against their depth
follow 'The regime this window sat in' to /recorder/regime
read each series' composition against its covered span
read 'Now' apart from the window before acting on either

accessibility.notes: Failed reads carry role=alert per affected series. Regime labels render as <code>. No tables; everything is prose inside a max-w-2xl main.
